testcase.system-out: Scenario: Display templates as details ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔> And the native catalog contains metric and inch templates in their respective folders ✔> And the catalog root has no direct template files ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user presses Control+N to open the new-document template chooser ✔ And the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the selected template folder contains templates ✔ When the user opens the template display menu ✔ Then the menu offers icon sizes, List, Details, and Grouped by Type ✔ When the user chooses Details ✔ Then the template gallery displays rows with Name, Size, and Type columns ✔ And the template details pane remains visible
